narrative:
Ashland County has 33,558 registered voters, with 50.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 38.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 10.9%, a pronounced Republican lean of 27.3 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.6% of registrants.
